US House Representatives win reelection bids

Democrats Doris Matsui and Republican María Elvira Salazar have won reelection to the U.S. House of Representatives. Matsui secured victory in California's 7th Congressional District, defeating a progressive challenger. Salazar won her race in Florida, a contest marked by her past clashes with Donald Trump.
